name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.SpeechVoiceTiktokMallPopupLandingActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a user opens the pop-up product offer from a short-video shopping ad. It shows the promoted product in a smaller pop-up landing page.
disableEffect: The pop-up product offer and its shopping link will no longer open.
